script.title: PICKING RIPE AVOCADOS
script.story_hook: One wrong squeeze and dinner turns brown.
script.intro_zh: 捏錯一顆，晚餐就變成黑褐色。
script.welcome_en: Hello again, glad you dropped by! Today we pick avocados that are just right.
script.welcome_zh: 又見面啦，歡迎你！今天我們挑剛好的酪梨。
script.outro: Ripe and ready, just like today's English. See you soon!
script.outro_zh: 熟度剛好，英文也是！我們很快再見。
script.practice_intro_en: Let's read along, one sentence at a time.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一句一句一起讀。
script.char_a_description: a tall woman in her fifties with a chin-length silver bob, wearing an olive linen shirt and rolled beige trousers, examining produce labels with amused squints
script.char_b_description: a lanky young man with a blonde shaggy mullet, wearing a brown produce apron over a denim shirt, tossing avocados gently from hand to hand
script.youtube_title: 【🥑挑酪梨英文】🤏「輕輕捏怎麼講」🧺熟度、紙袋、冷藏一次學會｜Avocado Shopping English
script.youtube_title_en: “Gentle Squeeze!” — Picking Ripe Avocados at the Store
script.youtube_description:
買回家的酪梨總是外綠內黑？這段生鮮課長教你三招挑熟度！在超市蔬果區，跟著 Ruth 一起輕捏測試、看果蒂顏色、用紙袋催熟、冷藏保存。整段 18 句美式日常英語，附上繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽一遍就會開口用。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Always bringing home avocados that are green outside and brown inside? A produce clerk shares three tricks in this real supermarket dialogue. Follow Ruth through the squeeze test, the stem check, paper bags, and the fridge — 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA, plus line-by-line repeat practice in the second half.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🥑挑酪梨英文｜輕捏試熟度・果蒂看顏色・紙袋催熟｜聽完就會用｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
酪梨買回家切開，裡面全是黑的？
「輕輕捏」這種話用英文該怎麼講？

這一集帶大家走進超市蔬果區，Ruth 想挑今晚能吃的酪梨，課長教她捏、彈果蒂、看顏色，還傳了紙袋與冷藏的保存撇步。

你會聽到：
🤏 試熟度：例如「which avocado is ready for tonight?」、「it feels kind of soft」。
🟤 看果蒂辨好壞：例如「the stem trick: flick it, see the color」、「brown means it's gone bad inside」。
🧺 保存與加購：例如「a paper bag, two days, counter, done」、「do you sell guacamole too」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次站在酪梨堆前，你也能一邊挑一邊用英文聊天！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, which avocado is ready for tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ wɪtʃ ˌɑːvəˈkaːdoʊ ɪz ˈrɛdi fɔːr təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 請問哪顆酪梨今晚就能吃？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the dark ones, not bright green.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ðə dɑːrk wʌnz nɑːt braɪt ɡriːn/
dialogue.zh: 挑深色那幾顆，別拿亮綠的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like this one? It feels kind of soft.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk ðɪs wʌn ɪt fiːlz kaɪnd əv sɔːft/
dialogue.zh: 這顆嗎？摸起來有點軟軟的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gentle squeeze! If it dents, it's too far.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdʒɛntəl skiːz ɪf ɪt dɛnts ɪts tuː fɑːr/
dialogue.zh: 輕輕捏！按出凹痕就是熟過頭了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oops, mine's mushy. How do you know so fast?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʊps maɪnz ˈmʌʃi haʊ du ju noʊ soʊ fæst/
dialogue.zh: 哎呀，我這顆爛軟了。你怎麼看這麼快？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The stem trick: flick it, see the color.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə stɛm trɪk flɪk ɪt siː ðə ˈkʌlər/
dialogue.zh: 看果蒂頭：輕彈一下，觀察顏色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Green under it? Perfect, dinner is saved.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡriːn ˈʌndər ɪt ˈpɜːrfɪkt ˈdɪnər ɪz seɪvd/
dialogue.zh: 底下是綠的？太好了，晚餐有救了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Brown means it's gone bad inside, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /braʊn miːnz ɪts ɡɔːn bæd ɪnˈsaɪd ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 變棕色就是裡面壞掉了，要注意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's exactly my luck from last week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ɪɡˈzæktli maɪ lʌk frʌm læst wiːk/
dialogue.zh: 上週我就剛好碰到一顆這樣的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It happens. Want one for tomorrow instead?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈhæpənz wɑːnt wʌn fɔːr təˈmɑːroʊ ɪnˈstɛd/
dialogue.zh: 難免啦。要不要換一顆明天吃的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes please! How do I keep it from going bad?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pliːz haʊ du aɪ kiːp ɪt frʌm ˈɡoʊɪŋ bæd/
dialogue.zh: 好啊！怎麼讓它別那麼快壞？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A paper bag, two days, counter, done.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈpeɪpər bæɡ tuː deɪz ˈkaʊntər dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 裝進紙袋，放枱上兩天就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the fridge stops it after that, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ənd ðə frɪdʒ stɑːps ɪt ˈæftər ðæt raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 之後放冰箱就能按住，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly. Cold slows it down, trust me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli koʊd sloʊz ɪt daʊn trʌst miː/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，低溫會讓它熟得慢，信我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. Do you sell guacamole too, by the way?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑːt ɪt du ju sɛl ˌɡɑːkəˈmoʊli tuː baɪ ðə weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 對了，你們也有賣酪梨醬嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Aisle four, fridge side, it never lets us down.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl fɔːr frɪdʒ saɪd ɪt ˈnɛvər lɛts ʌs daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 四號通道，冰箱那側，從不讓我們失望。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect run. Thanks for the avocado lesson!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜːrfɪkt rʌn θæŋks fɔːr ðə ˌɑːvəˈkaːdoʊ ˈlɛsən/
dialogue.zh: 這趟太完美了。謝謝你的酪梨教學！
